versions.subject: Added two new lolbas rules and slight modifications on exisiting rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\msedge.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'msedge.exe'
selection_cmd:
    - CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--gpu-launcher='
        - '&&'
    - ParentCommandLine|contains|all:
        - '--gpu-launcher='
        - '&&'
condition: selection_img and selection_cmd
versions.spl: Image="*\\msedge.exe" OR OriginalFileName="msedge.exe" (CommandLine="*--gpu-launcher=*" CommandLine="*&&*") OR (ParentCommandLine="*--gpu-launcher=*" ParentCommandLine="*&&*")
